products.name: Acoustic One Wireless Headphones
products.description: Precision-engineered active noise cancellation headphones with custom neodymium 40mm drivers, 36-hour battery life, and ultra-soft memory foam ear cushions.

Lossless 24-bit audio playback via USB-C or Bluetooth 5.3

reviews.comment: The sound profile out of the box is incredible. Heavy, premium build.
